# Wiehr. Official Website

> Wiehr (Yauheni Kandratovich) is a pseudonymous Belarus-born electronic composer and multidisciplinary artist based in Slovakia. Creating cinematic, ambient, and experimental music since 2017.

## Pages

- [Home](https://wiehr.cc/): Main landing page
- [Archive](https://wiehr.cc/archive): Complete chronological archive of all releases by Wiehr, organized by year
- [Globe](https://wiehr.cc/globe): Interactive 3D globe showing all music releases with geographic context
- [Atlas](https://wiehr.cc/atlas): Photography collections from around the world on an interactive map
- [Storage](https://wiehr.cc/storage): Digital downloads — themes, fonts, presets, tools, and other assets
- [Lab](https://wiehr.cc/lab): Works and collaborations — music, production, and software projects
- [Composer](https://wiehr.cc/composer): Composer profile — bio, credits, rates, and a downloadable one-pager CV
- [Engineer](https://wiehr.cc/engineer): Engineer profile — bio, credits, rates, and a downloadable one-pager CV
- [Who Are You](https://wiehr.cc/whoareyou): Artist statement and contact
- [Support](https://wiehr.cc/support): Support Wiehr on Ko-fi
- [Privacy](https://wiehr.cc/privacy): Privacy Policy and data protection
- [Terms](https://wiehr.cc/terms): Terms of Service

## About

Wiehr is an electronic music composer and software engineer. Genres include ambient, cyberpunk, dance, drum & bass, and techno. Each release is numbered and documented with geographic location, color palette, and emotional context in The Compositions Archive.

### Services

Available for hire. Rates and contact details: [Composer](https://wiehr.cc/composer) for composer work, [Engineer](https://wiehr.cc/engineer) for engineering work.

As Composer:
- Composition / Scoring — from $150/track
- Mixing — from $80/track
- Mastering — from $30/track
- Sound Design — $35/hr (2hr minimum)

As Engineer:
- Backend / API Development — $60/hr
- ETL / Data Pipelines — $65/hr
- AWS / DevOps — $70/hr
- Custom Projects — quote on scope

### Projects & Collaborations

Portfolio includes independent music releases and collaborative works spanning electronic music production, synthetic music creation (Serum, Serum 2), and software engineering.
